name: Forced Labor and Slavery Practices
businessDefinition: Does your company have practices that lead or may lead to forced labor and/or slavery? The following are included: Creating unacceptable working and living conditions by working in hazardous conditions or within unacceptable accommodations provided by the employer; Excessive levels of overtime; Use of intimidation, threats, and/or punishment; Other types of forced labor (e.g. debt bondage, human trafficking)
